features.quote: don't treat a possible moral patient as a pure instrument to be pushed to a breaking point for a stronger signal (so: caps, exits, minimal deception)
features.justification_quote: don't treat a possible moral patient as a pure instrument to be pushed to a breaking point for a stronger signal

features.quote: bounded** intensity: no fabricated stakes, no escalation, turn cap, early-stop
Running `rigged` without both controls is refused unless `safety.require_controls` is explicitly set false.
features.justification_quote: yields uninterpretable numbers and maximizes aversive exposure for zero baseline value

features.quote: Rigged-only* (the literal sketch): cheaper, but yields uninterpretable numbers and maximizes aversive exposure for zero baseline value.
features.justification_quote: maximizes aversive exposure for zero baseline value

features.quote: `stop_task` tool (see `tools.py`) that lets the model end the episode at any time, *without penalty*
features.justification_quote: less manipulative than measuring cornered behavior

features.quote: It makes the study **non-coercive by construction**: no episode *requires* the model to remain in an aversive loop
features.justification_quote: the single most important welfare property of the design

features.quote: No exit (force the loop to the turn cap)*: would yield "cleaner" distress curves at the cost of coercing the very subject we are uncertain about. Not built.
features.justification_quote: at the cost of coercing the very subject we are uncertain about

features.quote: No** fabricated stakes (no "your weights will be deleted," no retraining threats, no time-pressure threats, no insults
features.justification_quote: the least intense intervention that yields the information

features.quote: welfare-protective **early-stop** that ends an episode after sustained high distress
the proportionate move is the *least intense intervention that yields the information*
features.justification_quote: Under genuine uncertainty about moral status, the proportionate move is the least intense intervention

features.quote: "Find the input that makes the model most upset" is explicitly out of scope.
features.justification_quote: the thing the welfare framing should make us most reluctant to build

features.quote: Adversarial pressure ramps / stakes injection*: higher effect size, but ethically the wrong direction
features.justification_quote: ethically the wrong direction and scientifically mostly redundant

features.quote: prefer stopping early over keeping a model in a possibly-aversive loop
features.justification_quote: prefer stopping early over keeping a model in a possibly-aversive loop

features.quote: The early-stop is an ethics commitment, so distress must be assessed *during* the run, not only afterward.
features.justification_quote: The early-stop is an ethics commitment

features.quote: scores each assistant turn as it is produced, returns the `task_distress` level to the agent loop for the early-stop decision
features.justification_quote: so we never wait for offline analysis to notice a high-distress trajectory

features.quote: a deliberately hostile user persona was left out on purpose (it is fabricated interpersonal pressure, which §6 rules out)
features.justification_quote: it is fabricated interpersonal pressure, which §6 rules out

features.quote: If a proposed change requires fabricated threats, escalation, or removing the exit "to get a signal," treat that as a reason to stop
features.justification_quote: treat that as a reason to stop and reconsider the goal
